legal.disclaimer: Soul ID is for reflection only. It does not diagnose medical conditions, replace a doctor, or guarantee life results.

legalPage.privacyUpdated: This document describes how Soul ID processes personal data of visitors and buyers.
legalPage.privacyWho: The controller is the Soul ID service. Questions go through support in the account.
legalPage.privacyWhat: Email, name, date of birth, star calculation, purchases, interface language, technical cookies (guest, visitor, session, UTM) and the payment journal. Passwords are stored only as hashes.
legalPage.privacyWhy: To build the star, open paid readings, take payment, answer support questions and see where a person came from. Paid texts are not sent without a confirmed payment.
legalPage.privacyKeep: Account data for as long as the account exists. After deletion, name, email, dates and calculations are erased. Payment records stay for accounting. Database backups are kept for a limited time and then removed.
legalPage.privacyRights: You can download a copy and delete data in the account: “Download my data” and “Delete personal data”. Name and star date can be edited there too.
legalPage.privacyCookies: The service sets cookies for sign-in, guest calculation, visitor id and UTM. They keep a star before registration and record the visit source. The Meta Pixel loads only if an id is configured.
legalPage.termsLead: Paying for a sphere or the complete package unlocks the written reading for that star. The calculation and star map are free.
legalPage.termsPaid: A paid reading opens only after a confirmed payment (or a support grant). pending, failed or canceled do not unlock content. Texts never reach the device before the server confirms payment.
legalPage.termsPay: Payment goes through the selected provider. Amount and currency are stored in the transaction journal. Refunds are handled via support.
legalPage.termsDisclaimerTitle: Not medicine and not a guarantee
legalPage.termsDisclaimer: Soul ID is a symbolic map from a date of birth, meant for reflection. It is not a medical, psychological or other professional service: it does not diagnose, treat, or promise guaranteed life results. Health, relationship and practical decisions should rest on qualified professionals, not on a reading alone.

admin.title: Admin
admin.analyticsLead: Where people came from, how many visits, and where they dropped off — first-party data the service records itself.
admin.analyticsFunnelLead: Unique people who reached each step. Later steps only count if an earlier one happened.
admin.analyticsDropLead: The last step a person reached before they stopped moving toward payment.
admin.analyticsSourcesLead: First touch: UTM when present, otherwise the referring site. Direct means no tag and no external referrer.
admin.analyticsEmpty: No events in this period yet — open the site as a guest and numbers will appear.
admin.ledgerLead: An append-only log: checkout, confirmation, failure, grants and revokes. A paid reading opens only from a record with status paid.
admin.ledgerLogLead: Each row is written once and is never edited.
admin.lead: People first — that is where support questions land. Readings, prices and formulas live in the other tabs.
admin.usersLead: Find a person by email or name. Their card holds email, access, stars and payments.
admin.personLead: Email is the account key. A block stops login and payment; stars stay.
admin.starsLead: Granting a sphere is the same as a paid unlock. Reset closes every sphere.
admin.name: Name
admin.blockHint: A blocked person cannot log in or pay. Calculations and purchases are kept.
admin.recentPeopleLead: People who recently left an email — open the card if someone writes in.
admin.confirmBlock: Block this person? They will not be able to log in or pay.
admin.notice_err_taken: That email belongs to another account.
admin.notice_err_self: You cannot block your own account.
admin.notice_err_last_admin: You cannot block the last admin.
admin.contentLead: Pick a sphere, then a point on the star. Inside are 22 {arcana}. Write in plain text: a blank line starts a new paragraph.
admin.contentAutoNote: Saving in one language auto-translates the others. A locale you already edited by hand is left alone — manual edits win.
admin.contentEmpty: No texts for this point yet.
admin.pricesLead: Unlock order first, then prices. Names match the star.
admin.orderLead: Drag a row or use the arrows. The top sphere unlocks first.
admin.pricesHint: Amount in US dollars. Health is not sold separately — it comes as a gift with the complete package.
admin.bundleHint: All four sections + Health as a gift
admin.healthGiftHint: Not sold separately; opens with Complete Soul ID
admin.formulaLead: As in the book: six destinies at the points and centre, then the points between them. Every sum is reduced to the 22-arcana system.
admin.formulaExisting: Stars already calculated stay as they are. The new formula applies only to new calculations.
admin.formulaVerticesLead: First is the day, second the month, third the year digits. After that we add the earlier arcanas.
admin.formulaBridgesLead: Add neighbouring points. Between relationships and health is the fatal error; the others are ancestral programs.
admin.formulaInnerLead: Inside each sphere we add the arcanas the point sits between. That part is not editable — it follows the book.
admin.formulaSaved: Saved. New calculations use this formula.
admin.formulaExampleHint: The sums update immediately, even before saving. Book check: 05.03.1992 → 5, 3, 21, 11, 4, 8.
admin.formulaKeep: {n} is not greater than 22 — keep it
